events.title: Interim Report 2026, January - September
events.text: "We continue to operate in a challenging market environment. However, through a strengthened market presence, the successful integration of UBC, and ongoing efficiency improvements, we are building an even stronger platform for sustainable and profitable long-term growth." Third quarter * Net sales amounted to SEK 615.9 million (528.5), an increase of 16.5 percent. Organic growth was -1.5 percent * EBITA amounted to SEK 82.7 million (79.7), corresponding to a margin of 13.4 percent (15.1) * EBIT amounted to SEK 68.0 million (76.1), corresponding to a margin of 11.0 percent (14.4) * Items affecting comparability amounted to SEK -9.5 million (-) * Profit before tax amounted to SEK 53.8 million (63.1) * Earnings per share amounted to SEK 0.76 (0.92) * Free cash flow amounted to SEK 76.4 million (86.1) First nine months * Net sales amounted to SEK 1,791.4 million (1,695.3), an increase of 5.7 percent. Organic growth was 1.0 percent * EBITA amounted to SEK 256.4 million (256.6), corresponding to a margin of 14.3 percent (15.1) * EBIT amounted to SEK 225.9 million (245.9), corresponding to a margin of 12.6 percent (14.5) * Items affecting comparability amounted to SEK -18.5 million (-) * Profit before tax amounted to SEK 190.0 million (203.7) * Earnings per share amounted to SEK 2.67 (2.87) * Free cash flow amounted to SEK 58.2 million (209.2) Significant events January-September * A contingent consideration of SEK 18.2 million relating to the acquisition of Thebalux was paid during the first quarter * Svedbergs Group acquired a majority stake in Czech company UBC during the second quarter +-------------+---------+-----------+---------+---------+---------+----------+ | | Jul-Sep |
